hints.title: Asymmetric Array Length Exploitation
hints.text: Note the asymmetric constraints: nums1 length is at most 1,000, while nums2 length is up to 100,000.

hints.title: Frequency Map on nums2
hints.text: maintain nums2 values in an array and track their frequencies using a hash map.

hints.title: O(1) Add and O(N1) Count
hints.text: when add is called, decrement the old value count and increment the new value count in the hash map.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map tracks nums2 frequencies while nums1 is iterated sequentially on count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs (i, j) on each count operation takes O(N1 * N2) = 10^8 operations, timing out quickly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map on nums2 provides O(1) add and O(N1) count queries with O(N2) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should observe the constraint difference (N1 <= 1,000) and design asymmetric querying.
